events.title: Cooking & Fishing system - Work in progress!🐟
events.summary: We told you about it; we are working on the fishing & cooking system, which goes hand in hand. First you fish, then you cook, seems good right? 🍣 Cooking will bring more depth to the game by giving you bonuses when you explore the different biomes. Different foods will have different effects, and to cook well, you need ingredients, including fish. 🦐 These fish will be collectable in the various biomes.
